text: I'm a student at the moment. I'm in my third year at university in Almaty, studying economics, although I also do some part-time work at a café at weekends, mainly to cover my living costs and get a bit of real work experience.

tips.en: It answers at once, then adds the year, the city and the subject.
tips.kk: Сұраққа бірден жауап беріп, сосын курсты, қаланы және мамандықты нақтылайды.
tips.ru: Сразу отвечает на вопрос, затем уточняет курс, город и специальность.
tips.example: I'm in my third year at university in Almaty

tips.en: Although brings in a second part of life — the part-time job — and makes the answer lively.
tips.kk: Although өмірдің екінші бөлігін — қосымша жұмысты — енгізіп, жауапты жандандырады.
tips.ru: Although вводит вторую часть жизни — подработку — и делает ответ живым.
tips.example: although I also do some part-time work at a café at weekends

note.en: Shows this is true now, not forever.
note.kk: Бұл тұрақты емес, қазіргі жағдай екенін көрсетеді.
note.ru: Показывает, что это сейчас, а не навсегда.

questions.question: Do you work or are you a student?

text: Mainly because I've always been good with numbers, and I was curious about how businesses actually make decisions. To be honest, my parents also encouraged me, since economics graduates tend to find jobs fairly easily in Kazakhstan, so it felt like a practical choice as well.

tips.en: A personal reason and a practical one — fuller than just “because I like it”.
tips.kk: Жеке себеп және практикалық себеп — жауап жай «ұнайды» дегеннен толығырақ.
tips.ru: Личная причина и практическая — ответ полнее, чем одно «потому что нравится».
tips.example: Mainly because I've always been good with numbers

tips.en: I’ve always been is the right tense for something true from the past until now.
tips.kk: I’ve always been — өткеннен қазірге дейін созылатын нәрсеге дәл шақ.
tips.ru: I’ve always been — точное время для того, что длится с прошлого до сейчас.
tips.example: I've always been good with numbers

note.en: An honest aside that sounds natural.

questions.question: Why did you choose that subject?

text: I'd say it's the case studies we do in seminars. Instead of just memorising theory, we look at what real companies did and argue about whether they made the right call. It's much more engaging than lectures, and I've learned a lot from my classmates' opinions.

tips.en: Not “everything is interesting” but one specific thing and why it appeals.
tips.kk: «Бәрі қызық» емес, неге ұнайтыны түсіндірілген бір нақты нәрсе.
tips.ru: Не «всё интересно», а одна конкретная вещь с объяснением, почему она нравится.
tips.example: it's the case studies we do in seminars

tips.en: Comparing with lectures shows why it is better.
tips.kk: Дәрістермен салыстыру оның неге жақсырақ екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Сравнение с лекциями показывает, почему это лучше.
tips.example: It's much more engaging than lectures

note.en: Contrasts the old and new way of learning.
note.kk: Оқудың ескі және жаңа тәсілін қарама-қарсы қояды.
note.ru: Противопоставляет старый и новый способ учиться.

note.en: An idiom meaning “made the right decision”.

questions.question: What do you like most about your studies?

text: Definitely the workload in exam periods. We often have three or four deadlines in the same week, and it's quite hard to balance that with my job. I've started planning everything in a calendar, though, which has made things a lot less stressful.

tips.en: The speaker does not just complain but says what they do about it.
tips.kk: Автор жай шағымданбай, мәселемен не істейтінін де айтады.
tips.ru: Автор не только жалуется, но и говорит, что делает с проблемой.
tips.example: I've started planning everything in a calendar

tips.en: The number of deadlines makes the difficulty real.
tips.example: three or four deadlines in the same week

note.en: The exact topic word for the amount of work.

questions.followUp: How do you deal with that?
questions.question: Is there anything difficult about your studies?

text: Ideally, I'd like to work as an analyst for an international company, maybe in Astana or even abroad for a few years. But I'm keeping my options open, because the job market changes so quickly that it's hard to plan too far ahead.

tips.en: Ideally and but show both the dream and realism.
tips.kk: Ideally және but арманды да, шынайылықты да көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Ideally и but показывают и мечту, и реализм.
tips.example: Ideally, I'd like to work as an analyst

tips.en: The speaker explains why they avoid fixed plans.
tips.kk: Автор неге қатаң жоспар құрмайтынын түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Автор объясняет, почему не строит жёстких планов.
tips.example: it's hard to plan too far ahead

questions.followUp: Would you like to work abroad?
questions.question: What would you like to do after you finish your studies?
